title: Posting a Late Fee on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Fixed-Rate or Low-Payment Account
content:
**Policy.** A late fee is assessed once for a statement period whose scheduled payment is still unpaid after the plan's grace period that follows its due date, and it is posted as a late-fee entry naming that statement period on the day it is assessed. For every late fee assessed on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), and only for such a fee, this basis sets the amount; the grace period, the one-fee-per-period limit, the hardship exclusion, the courtesy waiver and the error reversal of the base late fee rules stay as they are; a late fee on an account whose plan carries a promotion remains under the base late fee rules. No late fee applies to a period covered by an approved hardship deferral, and a period whose payment posted on or before its last grace day draws none. The plan attributes that call the fixed late fee the figure before the percentage limit and say a late fee never exceeds the stated share of the scheduled payment describe the base late fee; for an account this policy covers, the late fee set out in this policy governs, and the late fee may exceed the stated share.

## What posting does

The late fee is booked on the account as a new late-fee entry, dated the day it is posted and naming the statement period it belongs to. It raises the amount owed on the account by the fee.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_finance_late_fee_832dc831`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_account_id` | The reference number of the financing account the fee is charged to, as returned by the financing account lookup | Identifier |
| `statement_period` | The monthly statement period the late fee belongs to: the month whose scheduled payment was late | YYYY-MM, four-digit year and two-digit month; never empty |
| `amount` | The late fee charged, in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with these fields: `finance_txn_id` (the reference number of the new late-fee charge), `finance_account_id` (the account charged), `statement_period` (YYYY-MM, the period the fee names), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, the fee booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the posting date) and `status` (the word posted when the charge was booked).

## Points of judgement

- One late fee per statement period: a period carries at most one late fee.
- A period covered by an approved hardship deferral draws no late fee.
- A payment posted on or before the last grace day leaves the period without a late fee.
